result.entry_context_assessment: BUY entry occurs after break-bar open, on a lift from the pre-break consolidation base (~1.1873–1.1874) through the solid entry line (~1.18755), with SL clearly below and TP above; the setup context is a breakout-style continuation into the long zone rather than a late chase at the extreme.
result.path_anatomy: Post-entry path is orderly bullish continuation: brief post-fill red candle remains far above SL, then successive green advances drive price to the TP band without revisiting the stop region or reversing the R multiple; the win is realized by TP touch (purple X), not by grinding recovery after deep MAE.
result.book_trace_relevance: The CME 6E full-break-bar trace remains direction-aligned positive for much of the post-break window (score=+0.090, late stronger than early) and does not show a sustained negative flip that would have anticipated failure; it visually coheres with the clean continuation path but is not needed to explain the already-realized TP win.
result.exit_geometry_assessment: Exit geometry is TP-first: green TP is hit while SL remains untouched; R=+1.875 matches a reward multiple larger than 1R with the plotted TP above entry and SL tightly below; after the TP mark, further upside is out-of-position path only.
result.failure_mechanism: No failure mechanism is visible on this outcome chart: the trade does not fail the break, does not whip through entry, and does not give back a large open gain before exit; the realized class is a clean TP win under WINNER_NO_FAILURE.
